messages.subject: `choiceRT_ddm` change the `delta` limit
parts:
Hi,


Thank you for the great package `hBayesDM`. When using the `choiceRT_ddm`
function to model my choice time data, I found the value of parameter `delta (drift rate)` was limited above zero (>0). However, in many research the `delta` could also a value below zero. So, I want to known how to revised the .stan file to make the value of parameter `delta` range from -Inf to Inf (or -10~10). I try to remove the <lower=0> associated with delta in the .stan file, but it did not work, the estimated delta still above zero.

Another problem is when using the `choiceRT_ddm`
function, if there are some participants only made one kind of choice, the function will not run. Is it possible to fix the problem.

Thanks so much.

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: `choiceRT_ddm` change the `delta` limit
parts:
Hi Bo,

Sorry for the delayed reply. 

Basically, you need to add a new model to hBayesDM after changing the prior settings by following this tutorial: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/wiki/1.-Contributing-to-hBayesDM. We are trying to make it easier to add new models/tasks.
if there are some participants only made one kind of choice, the function will not run. Is it possible to fix the problem.

--> If I understood it correctly, probably it's better to remove the (outlier) subject. 

Best,
Young
